change: The v2 identifier names isolated per-run memory of current and past instances of the same permitted depth observations. It introduces no additional observation source.
permitted_information: Current possibly noisy or biased measured depths
Earlier instances of those same measured depths stored in isolated per-run state
Declared static model geometry and controller parameters
prohibited_information: Noise-free true simulator depth as a separate control input
Active fault catalog, timing, type or hidden status
Future observations, terminal metrics or heldout outcomes
invariant_requirements: Every reference and candidate run uses the same v2 experiment/context information-boundary identifier
Controller state is constructed empty inside every run_simulation invocation
Controller code receives only observations, static geometry, parameters and its isolated state
unchanged: All development and heldout acceptance thresholds
The fixed development pair and reference policy
chronology: This clarification is recorded after phase 2 controller development began but before any phase 2 heldout execution or outcome. It is a disclosed identifier deviation, not a revision of the frozen protocol bytes.
authorization: Root agent accepted this semantic treatment before phase 2 execution; genuine expansion of the observable set is not authorized by this clarification.
required_report_statement: Phase 2 used causal-depth-history-feedback-v2 instead of the protocol's v1 identifier. A pre-execution clarification records isolated history of the same permitted observations; no transforms or acceptance criteria changed.
